title: Stopping Illegal Practice of Carpooling Arrangements Set Up via Online Chatgroups
what_it_is: Stopping Illegal Practice of Carpooling Arrangements Set Up via Online Chatgroups

sections.label: Illegal car-pooling enforcement and penalties
sections.summary: LTA enforces against illegal car-pooling, with fines and imprisonment for providers and matching services, and encourages booking via licensed platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) conducts enforcement actions against drivers who are found to have provided illegal car-pooling services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: An individual who provides an illegal car-pooling service may face a fine of up to $3,000, up to six months' imprisonment, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Those who provide an illegal car-pool matching service may face a fine of up to $10,000, up to six months' imprisonment, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: For safety, we strongly encourage commuters who wish to book point-to-point transport (P2P) services, including commercial car-pooling, to do so via licensed business platforms.

sections.label: Telegram carpool chatgroups
sections.summary: A Telegram search found five active SGHitch chatgroups, and carpooling for a fee is only legal via licensed business platforms in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: A quick search on Telegram last week using SGHitch already yields five different active chatgroups, the largest, having a member base of 49,115, and the smallest with a base of 3,000.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: In Singapore, it is only legal to carpool for a fee via licensed business platforms.

sections.label: Licensed and licence-exempt carpooling operators
sections.summary: Carpooling is allowed only through a licensed carpooling operator or a permitted licence-exempt operator with fewer than 800 cars.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As she has noted, currently, we only allow carpooling services if it is through a licensed carpooling operator or through a permitted licence-exempt operator, which is one that has got a fleet of less than 800 cars.

sections.label: Informal carpooling channels not allowed
sections.summary: Carpooling services acquired through informal channels like Telegram and SGHitch that are non-business entities are not allowed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Carpooling services acquired through informal channels like Telegram, SGHitch that are non-business entities are not allowed.
